name: 변수 관계 탐색 방법 비교
research_question: Do META STAT and GDN contribute distinct and useful candidate relations?
comparison: META versus STAT versus GDN at a common top-20 budget
dataset_scope: HAI 23.05 P1 normal-only discovery with a frozen 144-pair universe
current_evidence: All three arms executed and were audited; each produced a top-20 and their unscored union contains 47 pairs. This establishes diversity rather than unique useful contribution.
result_scope: Discovery artifacts exist; the comparative contribution experiment has not been performed.
primary_metrics: Seed and split stability; unique confirmed-relation contribution; downstream rule yield; edge and source masking analysis
limitations: No isolated ablation establishes that GDN-only candidates are stable or useful. Candidate edges are not causal.
next_action: Preregister fixed seeds splits masks and downstream confirmation outcomes.
claim_impact: GDN implementation is supportable; unique scientific benefit is unvalidated.

name: 규칙 수치 기준 비교
research_question: How do relation-rule response time tolerance and persistence criteria affect validity and utility?
comparison: Alternative preregistered rule numeric criteria; D0 PCA threshold tuning is excluded
dataset_scope: Normal-only P1 profiling and calibration; later utility requires separate authority
current_evidence: Normal-only numeric authority and frozen references are implemented and audited. Formal comparative validation is incomplete.
result_scope: Current references support deterministic execution but do not establish optimal criteria.
primary_metrics: Validity retention; abstention; firing behavior; normal false-alarm burden; separately frozen attack-event response
limitations: Fit confirmation lag tolerance and persistence sensitivity remains untested. Labels may not select numeric authority.
next_action: Design a normal-data-only comparative protocol and freeze candidate criteria before label-aware evaluation.
claim_impact: Numeric provenance is supportable; optimality or superiority is not.

name: 검증 피드백 기반 규칙 생성 비교
research_question: Does bounded verifier feedback improve rule construction over deterministic one-shot and budget-matched controls?
comparison: T0 versus T1 versus T1-B versus T2
current_evidence: T0 T1 and T1-B accepted 42 of 42; T2 accepted 39 of 42. T2 performed zero feedback actions so feedback was not empirically exercised.
result_scope: One frozen construction cohort; validity and cost observations only.
primary_metrics: Accepted yield; no-rule count; issue distribution; feedback actions and recoveries; provider-call cost
limitations: The current cohort contains no exercised feedback-recovery path and utility was not tested in this comparison.
next_action: If retained then preregister an independent repairable cohort with a budget-matched T1-B control.
claim_impact: The four paths executed; agentic verifier-feedback advantage is not supported by this pilot.

name: 검증된 관계 규칙의 이상탐지 성능 비교
research_question: Can verified rules detect attacks while controlling normal false-alarm episodes alone or with a detector?
comparison: D0 detector-only versus D1 Rule-only versus D2 policies
dataset_scope: HAI 23.05 P1 INNER with 14 independent attack events; no OUTER result
current_evidence: Integrity-audited INNER results exist. D1 responded to 13 of 14 with high FAR; D2 V1 and V2 responded to 11 of 14 and recovered none of three D0 misses.
primary_metrics: Attack-event Recall; Normal FAR episodes/hour; secondary D0-miss recovery
limitations: Small event count; high D1 FAR; negative D2 results; no held-out result; simple PCA-SPE baseline.
next_action: Expand independent event evidence and add a stronger multivariate detector after new preregistration.
claim_impact: Rule signal and D0-D1 complementarity are pilot observations; operational utility and fusion improvement are unsupported or unvalidated.

name: 규칙 설명의 일치성 검증
research_question: Does explanation output faithfully represent frozen rule trace numeric provenance and outcome without unsupported content?
comparison: Automated conformance across PASS FAIL and abstain; human usefulness is separate
dataset_scope: Synthetic and representative trace-grounded artifacts; no human study
current_evidence: A deterministic renderer and trace bindings are implemented and audited. A comprehensive explanation-consistency experiment has not run.
primary_metrics: Source and target match; direction and timing; provenance; outcome consistency; omission; unsupported content; reproducibility
limitations: Representative artifacts do not establish corpus-wide faithfulness or human understanding.
next_action: Preregister corpus-level faithfulness checks; add human evaluation only if thesis-essential.
claim_impact: Trace-grounded rendering is an implementation fact; broad faithfulness is conditional and human usefulness unvalidated.

name: 실시간 LLM 활용 비교
research_question: Can a future live-LLM arm be compared as an independent detector without receiving fixed-rule outcomes or ground truth?
comparison: Future R0 deterministic runtime versus separately authorized R1 live-LLM mode
dataset_scope: CONDITIONAL FUTURE; no current scientific result
current_evidence: The deployed fixed-rule runtime is LLM-free. No scientific authority establishes a real-time LLM detection comparison.
primary_metrics: To be preregistered after role input output latency cost and leakage boundaries are frozen
limitations: R1 must not receive R0 final alarm or normal outcome final violation or satisfaction test labels or ground truth.
next_action: Keep conditional and outside the current core contribution unless separately approved.
claim_impact: No live-LLM detection benefit claim is supportable; LLM-free wording applies only to the current fixed-rule runtime.
